ambiguities_or_notes: This unit is editorial variant apparatus containing Tolstoy readings; all chapter/page/line coordinates and every Instead of / in Sovremennik / absent relation are represented.
The repeated Russian forms восемнадцать / осьмнадцать are orthographic variants that collapse to the same English word 'eighteen'; the apparatus relation is nevertheless retained explicitly.
кунак is retained as kunak rather than generalized to 'friend', because it denotes the Caucasian guest-friend relationship in the military setting.
The card-game boundary в дурачки is retained as durachki (a form of the Russian fool card game) rather than mistranslated as an insult.
The lexical contrasts портки / порты and подлецы / молодцы are rendered as 'breeches / trousers' and 'scoundrels / fine fellows' to preserve the fact and direction of the printed variation.

No missing passage has been reconstructed from the base text; where the apparatus identifies only the opening and closing words of an omitted span, the English likewise translates only those boundary words.
